Optional dependencies are clearly marked and serve plugin functionality (e.g., notifications, Last.fm integration), which is consistent with the package description. There are no network operations, file manipulations, or scripts defined in this file — it is purely declarative metadata.

As `.SRCINFO` is not executable and only reflects package metadata generated from a PKGBUILD, there is no opportunity for code injection or malicious behavior in this file alone. The content matches expected AUR packaging practices and shows no signs of tampering or supply chain attack vectors.
